findings.summary: Never predicts inner_race (recall 0.00 on 24 fresh runs; always outer_race). The recorded 0.895 test accuracy comes from 2 test runs (normal + outer_race) with no inner_race run, so it never measured that class. Fresh runs: accuracy 0.58 (first 1 s) / 0.67 (steady state) vs. 0.33 majority baseline.
Trained at one speed (150 rad/s). Outside its trained range the classifier is confidently wrong; SPADE shows no diagnosis there.

trained_envelope.source: single operating point: trained at 150 rad/s only (docs/AI_TECHNICAL_AUDIT.md AI-N07 root cause; for 2026-10-13 also the rpm column of data/diagnosis_dataset_c1_5s.parquet, median 150 rad/s); declared 2026-11-16 (AI-N40, decision D1)
